'''Bantha-blood fizz''' was an unusual carbonated [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage made from purified [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. It was popular among some members of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as well as around the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
